profile.headline: Workday Senior Software Engineer at Wells Fargo
profile.jobTitle: Workday Senior Software Engineer - Workday Integrations

positions.title: Workday Senior Software Engineer - Workday Integrations
positions.description:
-Acts as a liaison between client area and technical organization by planning, conducting, and directing the analysis and engineering of highly complex, strategic, corporate-wide business problems to be solved with automated systems.

-Acts in a technical role providing technical guidance and consultation with application teams, clients, and Engineering Managers for their technology domain environments including but not limited to cloud, middleware, operating systems, applications, Software-as-a-Service, and Platform-as-a-Service products including Workday, Modern Hire, HackerRank.

-Design, develop and test Workday Studio Integrations
positions.insights: Skills: HRIS · Process Improvement · Workday Studio

positions.title: People Operations (Workday) Manager / Workday Sr Analyst
positions.description:
•	Workday Security, Benefits, Paid Time Off, Leaves, Reporting, Business Processes and HCM module Administrator.
•	Integrations SME (EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio)
•	Create, maintain and troubleshoot all integrations to and from Workday.
•	Experienced with Workday web services, XML and XSLT transformations.
•	Review, test and implement Workday bi-annual system upgrades; collaborating with functional and technical staff to coordinate the application of an upgrade or fix and documenting process and results.
•	Design, development, and deployment of new reports and alerts.
•	Partner with internal/external stakeholders for requirements and info gathering.
•	Build relationships with key user and operations groups to identify and resolve business issues.
•	Ensure system integrity and reliability.
•	Provide top tier support and issue resolution.

positions.title: HCM Implementation Project Manager / Oracle / ServiceNow
positions.description:
•	Project Manager for the implementation of Oracle HCM and ServiceNow HRSD.
•	Technical point of contact and HR systems subject matter expert.
•	Gathering requirements including the creation of data matrix, data conversion plans and system integrations coordination.
•	 Responsible for all phases of the HCM implementation including discovery, configuration, testing, deployment, post-go-live support in coordination with a third party implementation partner.
•	Partner with all functional HR areas to determine needs and solutions to implement best practices.
•	Ensure milestones are successfully met through oversight of the project.
•	Lead stakeholder update and status meetings.

positions.title: HRIS Analyst
positions.description:
•	Provide subject matter expertise and industry best practices related to business transformation.
•	Serves as a technology business partner to gather business requirements from key stakeholders and translates them into an effective system design
•	Create processes, procedures and training for all HR systems.
•	ServcieNow HRSD Administrator
•	Implementation, configuration and administration of Jobvite Applicant Tracking System
•	Configuration and support of ADP products during upgrade and ongoing efforts.
•	Implementation and administration of Halogen Performance Management System.
•	Responsible for reporting and compliance including AAP, EEO1, Vets and ACA

Accomplishments
o	Increased hiring efficiencies and streamlined on-boarding processes by integrating Jobvite ATS with Docusign, Sterling Talent Solutions and ADP.
o	Implemented online solutions and reduced reliance on paper documentation and significantly increased efficiencies.

positions.title: Senior Human Resources Analyst / HRIS
positions.description:
•Administered performance management and HRIS system (ADP), including carrier feeds, updates, system enhancements, table structure changes, benefits, employee portal and user issues/errors. 
Responsible for data integrity, security administration and tech support for HRIS systems. 
•Troubleshot HRIS systems and user issues to completion.
•Developed and distributed analytics from HRIS systems and all data and reports requests. 
•Responsible for all internal and external data and reports requests from HR Systems. 
•Compliance including AAP, EEO1, Vets and ACA.
•Managed LifeLock’s Immigration cases.
•Conducted salary surveys (Radford, Culpepper) and analyzed information to determine appropriate position compensation within market.
•Managed LifeLock’s Learning Assistance and regulatory transportation programs.
•Administered, configured and managed employee benefit programs settings, data feeds and open enrollment in all systems
•	Maintained Human Resources internal SharePoint site including monthly updates to organization charts.
•	Performed monthly internal audits needed to maintain company security protocols.
•	Responsible for administration of LifeLock’s leave administration plan.

positions.title: Sr. Recruiter / Sr. HR Generalist
positions.description:
•	Responsible for staffing, at all levels, of the Mountain Pass facility and supervision of recruitment staff.
•	Conducted investigations, partnered with managers on employee relations and policy issues.
•	Administered absence/leave management program (FMLA).
•	Supported / acted as backup to Human Resource Manager.
•	Administered compensation and benefits.
•	Conducted and developed an onboarding program, employee recognition program and sexual harassment training.
•	Provided leadership, established new/enhanced recruiting processes, updated job descriptions.
•	Facilitated and oversaw bidding processes with United Steel Workers local union.
•	Coordinated implementation of HR services, policies and programs.
•	Assured compliance with various federal, state and local laws.
•	Assisted with the development and administration of programs, procedures, and guidelines to help align the workforce with the strategic goals of the company.

positions.title: HR Generalist, International
positions.description:
•Work with legal counsel to localize policies and procedures in new markets.
•Responsible for managing work and travel visa process
•Assists Department Managers with the screening of potential candidates.
•Prepare offer letters and ensure appropriate approvals are made.
•Continue compliance initiative with relation to employment laws and practices within various countries.
•Handle exit interview process for terminating employees.
•Serve as back up to the International Human Resources Director in handling employee relations issues.

positions.title: Contract Recruiter
positions.description:
•Successfully recruited positions at all levels or the organization for the ramp up of two copper mines. Assisted in the opening / management of the local hiring center, trained and new recruiters in company processes and established procedures for the hiring center.
•Successfully recruited candidates in a full cycle recruiting process for various mine sites utilizing Taleo in a high volume environment for the largest copper mining company in the world.
•Utilized knowledge of various recruiting sources and techniques to identify candidates at various levels of the organization including laborers, managers, engineers and senior level positions.

positions.title: Manager for Recruiting
positions.description:
•	Successfully recruited over 12,000 applicants by developing and outlining strategic direction for the local Census office.
•	Successfully managed, developed and directed a team of 32 recruiters.
•	Identified and participated in networking activities such as career fairs and civic events to recruit talent and build relationships.
•	Developed ongoing, creative and cost-effective sourcing strategies.
•	Created, trained and managed a team of 22 customer service representatives.
•	Developed key relationships with local businesses, city officials, media and government agencies to meet US Census recruiting goals.  
•	Ability to work in a high-paced, deadline driven culture.

positions.title: HRIS / Generalist
positions.description:
•Partnered with management to communicate and consistently administer company policies, procedures, standards and governmental regulations in a multi state region.  
•Duties included full cycle recruiting, administration of pre-employment testing and new hire on boarding. Processed payroll as needed and provided employees assistance with payroll and benefit problem resolution.
•Partnered with management on employee retention issues and programs. 
•Responsible for development and delivery of all HR metrics, dashboards and report requests. 
•Implemented BrassRing applicant tracking system to enable and facilitate e-recruiting function. 
•Implemented a performance management system for 30,000 employees, including system selection, configuration and training of managers and employees on system and pm theory.
•Partnered with management to administer and effectively drive performance management for employee development. 
•Participated in the selection, configuration and implementation of two HRIS systems, one applicant tracking system and two performance management systems.  
•Participated in numerous corporate re-engineering teams and project roll outs that focused on HR best practices and procedures.
•Developed and delivered various online and instructor lead training for employees and managers.
•Coordinated annually salary planning, compensation surveys and developed job descriptions as needed.
